rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Something a little troublesome has come up.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Perhaps because of all the trouble we have caused, it seems we have pursuers on us.
<operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>Probably the work of the <book(41)>Sea of Lorelei<endbook()> escapees - the <color(5)>Frost brothers<ce()>. They have closed a fair distance<thumbnail(222)> on us.
<operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>That is not the only problem. There is a <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> base up ahead. We are completely caught in a pincer.
<operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>But we cannot afford to be held up here. The <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()> is waiting for us.
<thumbdown()><operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>Let us finish these guys off fast and head for New York.
rows.notes: Orchestrator: reworded to avoid a j/q glyph.

rows.en: <topic()><operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>Oh right, starting this time I will be sortieing in the <color(4)>Overman Emperanza<ce()><thumbnail(223)> too. Count on me.
